target: OMG SysML 1.7 / UML 2.5.1 with MagicDraw 2022x compatible serialization

bdd_projection.purpose: Block definitions, direct hierarchy composition, optional Port compartments

ibd_projection.internal_parts: only direct owned composite Part Properties
ibd_projection.connections: ConnectGraph Final Connection, keyed by connection_id
ibd_projection.signal_flow: one InformationFlow + one standard ItemFlow per SIGNAL connection
ibd_projection.physical_flow: Connector with inout interfaces; no forced one-way flow

solution_space_and_reference.rule: Final Connection/Net use or active profile port or explicit reference selection, plus necessary ancestors; explicit unselected variants remain Block definitions only.
solution_space_and_reference.note: This task does not publish a new full XMI or infer upward parent Ports.
